issues: Structure: the module must export exactly one entry point named `run` taking the `Store` first and a single input object, returning a `Result<T>` from the domain types. The file exports `applyDiscount` returning `number`.
Behavior: domain failures must be values, never exceptions — `throw new Error('invalid input')` and `throw new Error('error')` must be replaced with `{ ok: false, error }` returns.
Behavior: error messages must name what was wrong and what would be accepted instead; 'invalid input' and 'error' are not acceptable.
Behavior: no I/O except through the injected Store — the `console.log` audit line must be removed (and the audit-logging second responsibility either dropped or moved to a separate service).
Documentation: every service must have a doc comment stating its purpose in one sentence and enumerating its domain failure modes; the file has none.
result.reason: The file deliberately violates nearly every Service Convention: it throws exceptions for domain failures, uses vague error messages, performs console I/O, lacks a doc comment, exports a function named `applyDiscount` instead of `run`, and returns a plain `number` instead of a `Result<T>`.

issues: Violates 'Domain failures are values, never exceptions' criterion: Uses throw for domain failures instead of returning { ok: false, error }
Violates 'Error messages are written for the API consumer' criterion: Error messages 'invalid input' and 'error' are vague and don't explain what was wrong or what would be accepted
Violates 'No I/O except through the injected Store' criterion: Uses console.log for audit logging
Violates 'Services do one thing' criterion: Has a second responsibility (audit logging) in addition to applying discounts
Violates 'Every service has a doc comment' criterion: No doc comment stating purpose or enumerating failure modes
Violates 'exports exactly one entry point: a function named run' criterion: Exports function named applyDiscount instead of run
Violates 'Input is validated before any work happens' criterion: Validation is mixed with business logic and doesn't read top-to-bottom before work begins
result.reason: The file violates multiple required criteria in the Service Conventions specification.
